whoami.description: Answer questions to find out which Greek mythology character you are

quizz.name: quiz
quizz.description: Test your knowledge of Greek mythology with a quiz

zeus.name: Zeus
zeus.description: **Zeus** is the king of the gods, ruler of Mount Olympus, and lord of the sky. He has a dominant, impulsive, and charismatic personality, always ready to assert his authority. ⚡️

poseidon.name: Poseidon
poseidon.description: **Poseidon** is the god of the oceans, creator of storms and earthquakes. He has an impetuous, passionate, and vengeful personality, driven by raw emotions. 🌊

hera.name: Hera
hera.description: **Hera** is the queen of the gods and the protector of hearth and marriage. She has a proud, strategic, and unyielding personality when it comes to defending her status and principles. 👑

hades.name: Hades
hades.description: **Hades** is the ruler of the underworld and hidden riches. He has a solitary, extremely logical, and stoic personality, preferring the shadows to the light. 💀

athena.name: Athena
athena.description: **Athena** is the goddess of wisdom and military strategy. She has a thoughtful, methodical, and calm personality, always seeking the most just and rational solution. 🦉

apollo.name: Apollo
apollo.description: **Apollo** is the god of light, music, and the arts. He has a radiant, creative, and perfectionist personality, driven by the pursuit of harmony and excellence. 🎵

artemis.name: Artemis
artemis.description: **Artemis** is the goddess of the hunt, wild nature, and the moon. She has a fiercely independent personality, protective of her own, and detached from superficialities. 🏹

ares.name: Ares
ares.description: **Ares** is the god of brutal war and the chaos of combat. He has an explosive, reckless, and go-getter personality, never backing down from a fight. ⚔️

aphrodite.name: Aphrodite
aphrodite.description: **Aphrodite** is the goddess of beauty, seduction, and love. She has a captivating, expressive, and sometimes capricious personality, well aware of her power of attraction. ❤️

hephaestus.name: Hephaestus
hephaestus.description: **Hephaestus** is the god of fire, artisans, and the forges of Olympus. He has a persevering, ingenious, and reserved personality, expressing himself through his creations. 🔥

hermes.name: Hermes
hermes.description: **Hermes** is the messenger of the gods and the protector of travelers and tricksters. He has a sharp, mischievous, and highly adaptable personality, able to get out of any situation. 🕊️

dionysus.name: Dionysus
dionysus.description: **Dionysus** is the god of wine, theater, and letting go. He has an epicurean, festive, and unconventional personality, bringing energy and madness wherever he goes. 🍷

demeter.name: Demeter
demeter.description: **Demeter** is the goddess of the nourishing earth and harvests. She has a deeply empathetic, benevolent, and protective personality, ready to do anything for the well-being of her loved ones. 🌾

hercules.name: Hercules
hercules.description: **Hercules** is a demigod of superhuman strength, famous for his Twelve Labors. He has a courageous and impulsive personality, always ready to protect those close to him. 🦁

achilles.name: Achilles
achilles.description: **Achilles** is the greatest warrior of the Trojan War, invulnerable except for his heel. He has a proud, passionate, and highly reactive personality. 🗡️

odysseus.name: Odysseus
odysseus.description: **Odysseus** is the king of Ithaca, famous for his cunning, strategic mind, and long journey in the Odyssey. He has an extremely ingenious and tenacious personality. ⛵

perseus.name: Perseus
perseus.description: **Perseus** is the slayer of the Gorgon Medusa and the savior of Andromeda. He has a resourceful, thoughtful personality guided by a strong sense of justice. 🛡️

medusa.name: Medusa
medusa.description: **Medusa** is a Gorgon with a petrifying gaze and a head of snakes for hair. She has a distrustful, deeply solitary, and defensive personality, marked by her tragic past. 🐍

minotaur.name: The Minotaur
minotaur.description: **The Minotaur** is a half-man, half-bull monster trapped at the heart of the Labyrinth. He has a brutal, impulsive personality driven by a fierce and untamed instinct. 🐂

cerberus.name: Cerberus
cerberus.description: **Cerberus** is the three-headed dog guarding the Underworld. He has a fiercely loyal, incorruptible, and overprotective personality regarding his territory and master. 🐕

sphinx.name: The Sphinx
sphinx.description: **The Sphinx** is a winged creature with the body of a lion that devours those who fail her riddles. She has a mysterious, highly intellectual, and playful personality. 🦁

sirens.name: The Sirens
sirens.description: **The Sirens** are creatures with an enchanting song that lure sailors onto the rocks. They have a seductive, manipulative, and mischievous personality, using charm to achieve their ends. 🧜‍♀️

questions.conflict: When faced with an open argument, what is your first instinct?

conflict.a: I raise my voice to immediately restore order and assert my authority.
conflict.b: I play mediator, looking for a fair compromise for everyone.
conflict.c: Defuse the conflict with humor or a touch of irony.
conflict.d: I step back from the group; it's not my problem to solve.

ideal-space.a: An isolated, quiet place where nobody comes to bother me.
ideal-space.b: A lively place, surrounded by people with music and movement.
ideal-space.c: An ultra-organized and functional space where everything has its place.
ideal-space.d: A creative workshop or studio filled with ongoing projects.

ambiguous-task.a: I improvise on the spot based on my intuition.
ambiguous-task.b: I build a rigorous strategic plan before taking the slightest action.
ambiguous-task.c: I ask for the group's opinion to move forward together.
ambiguous-task.d: I handle it alone in my own way, without answering to anyone.

support.a: I take them under my wing and protect them at all costs.
support.b: I give them logical advice so they can solve the problem themselves.
support.c: It makes me uncomfortable, I prefer to keep my distance.
support.d: I use cunning or my connections to solve their problem behind the scenes.

unexpected-obstacle.b: Finding a creative workaround or a flaw in the system.
unexpected-obstacle.c: Coldly reassessing the situation and adjusting my approach.
unexpected-obstacle.d: Standing firm on my positions and waiting for the obstacle to give way.

social-event.a: I am the center of attention and the life of the party.
social-event.b: I stay with my close friends to make sure everyone is doing well.
social-event.c: I prefer to observe from a quiet corner.
social-event.d: I like to throw out little challenges or tease people.

daily-expression.a: Through art, style, music, or writing.
daily-expression.b: Through my achievements, status, and successes.
daily-expression.c: Through my sense of justice and fairness.
daily-expression.d: Through my humor, stories, and boldness.

greatest-strength.a: Your loyalty and your ability to care for others.
greatest-strength.c: Your boundless energy and limitless daring.

failure-reaction.a: I slam my fist on the table and immediately jump back in to get my revenge.
failure-reaction.b: I coldly analyze my mistakes so I never repeat them.
failure-reaction.c: I bypass the issue or find an excuse to land on my feet.
failure-reaction.d: I seek support from my loved ones to calmly review the situation.

unknown-place.a: I set off to explore the surroundings alone without waiting for anyone.
unknown-place.b: I analyze the location and establish a methodical mapping plan.
unknown-place.c: I immediately go meet the locals to make contact.
unknown-place.d: I go with the flow, guided by the atmosphere and my current instinct.
